en: Namaste 🙏 Most Mandir pujas are not live attendance — our pandit performs on your behalf with your name and gotra. You may pray quietly at home if you wish; it is not mandatory to sit through the whole ritual.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Zyada tar pujas live attendance nahi hoti — pandit ji aapke naam-gotra se puja karte hain. Chahein to ghar par shaant baith kar prarthna kar sakte hain; poori puja baithna zaroori nahi.

en: On puja day it is auspicious to avoid non-vegetarian food; a sattvic meal is recommended 🙏
hi: Puja ke din non-veg se bachna shubh mana jata hai; sattvic bhojan behtar hai 🙏

en: Please don’t worry — pandit ji performs the puja on your behalf with your Sankalp, so spiritual benefit is credited to you. You can watch the video later and offer a mental pranam 🙏
hi: Chinta na karein — pandit ji aapke sankalp se puja karte hain. Baad mein video dekh kar man hi man pranam kar sakte hain 🙏

en: As per traditional custom, many avoid touching puja items during periods. Since the puja is performed for you at the temple, it remains fully valid — you may listen to mantras from a distance 🙏
hi: Parampara ke anusar kai log periods mein puja samagri ko touch nahi karte. Puja mandir par aapke liye hoti hai — puja poori tarah valid rehti hai 🙏

en: Namaste 🙏 For your booked puja, Do's & Don'ts and recommended mantras are on your order in the LifeGuru app (Profile → that booking). We also send a PDF on WhatsApp from {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} — save it as “LifeGuru Puja Updates”. If you already booked, ask about “mantra” or “dos and donts” after we pull your order.
hi: Namaste 🙏 Booked puja ke Do's, Don'ts aur mantra app ke order page par hain. WhatsApp par PDF {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} se aata hai. Order select hone ke baad “mantra” ya “dos dont” pooch sakte hain.

en: Namaste 🙏 You do not need to be at the temple — pandit ji performs the puja on your behalf. If you sit and pray at home, wear clean, modest traditional or comfortable clothes and choose a quiet place 🙏 Puja-specific Do's & Don'ts (including dress guidance) are on your order in the app and in the PDF from {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} (“LifeGuru Puja Updates”).
hi: Namaste 🙏 Mandir par aapka hona zaroori nahi — pandit ji aapke naam-gotra se puja karte hain. Ghar par baith kar prarthna karein to saaf, modest/traditional kapde pehen kar shaant jagah choose karein 🙏 Dress code aur Do's/Don'ts app ke order page aur {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} se PDF par hain.

en: Please don’t worry — it is not mandatory for everyone to be physically present. The Sankalp is taken in everyone’s name; what matters most is intention and faith — blessings are received by all 🙏
hi: Chinta na karein — sab ka physically present hona zaroori nahi. Sankalp sab ke naam par hota hai; shraddha aur niyat mahatvapurn hai — ashirwad sab ko milta hai 🙏

en: We understand — if it was unintentional, that is absolutely fine. What truly matters is your faith, devotion, and pure intent 🙏
hi: Samajh sakte hain — agar galti se hua ho to theek hai. Asli baat aapki shraddha aur niyat hai 🙏

en: Yes, you can resume your normal routine after the puja. It is good to keep a peaceful, positive mindset for the rest of the day 🙏
hi: Haan, puja ke baad aam dincharya chalu kar sakte hain. Din bhar shaant aur positive rehna accha hota hai 🙏

en: Do's & Don'ts are sent to your registered WhatsApp from {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} — please save it as “LifeGuru Puja Updates” and follow them as best you can on puja day 🙏
hi: Do's & Don'ts aapke registered WhatsApp par {{PUJA_UPDATES_SENDER}} se bheje jate hain — “LifeGuru Puja Updates” save karein aur puja ke din follow karein 🙏

en: Yes 🙏 Your name and gotra are included in the Sankalp at the start of the puja.
hi: Haan 🙏 Puja shuru mein sankalp mein aapka naam aur gotra liya jata hai.
